title: HOA Premium Shock Town Hall
oneLiner: A meeting-room projector prototype that helps condo boards explain insurance non-renewal, dues hikes, reserves, and owner tradeoffs without chaos.
label: Fun / Field / Experimental
targetUser: Condo HOA board members, property managers, and homeowners facing insurance non-renewal or surprise premium hikes.
keyUX: Board imports the renewal shock, then presents a projector-friendly town hall flow: why it happened, options, dues impact, owner Q&A, and vote-ready tradeoffs.

sourceSignals.source: Reddit r/HOA, condo insurance non-renewal thread
sourceSignals.signal: HOA and condo communities report insurance non-renewal or large premium hikes, with owners asking what can be done before dues rise.

sourceSignals.source: Reddit r/orangecounty, homeowner premium jump thread
sourceSignals.signal: Orange County homeowners report 2026 premium jumps, carrier pullouts, deductible changes, and roof-age underwriting pressure.

spreadTrigger: Boards can use the projector mode in a real meeting and send the vote summary afterward.
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade web app prototype called "HOA Premium Shock Town Hall" for condo boards and property managers explaining insurance non-renewal or premium hikes to anxious owners. The first screen must be a working meeting-room projector tool with town-hall mode, premium shock explainer, carrier quote timeline, dues/reserve impact slider, roof/claim evidence wall, owner question queue, and vote-ready tradeoff summary. Use realistic sample data: carrier non-renewal letter, 4x quote, roof age concern, wildfire/flood risk note, reserve balance, $150/month dues impact, and three owner questions. Design direction: use the field-ops profile with large readable meeting controls, high-contrast status rows, reliable steel and graphite tones, and sparing orange/cyan accents for decision points. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
